ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions across both lobes; dense black pigmentation concentrated at the central notch and extending in a stippled, mottled pattern along the inferior margins of both lobes; isolated black focal spot in the upper-left quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 65 degrees and significant bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge with varied pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edges of the lobes as they taper toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, high-contrast, textured clusters of roughly circular light-colored pixels located at both distal tips of the fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Minor horizontal linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower interior section of the left lobe near the water interface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: One prominent, isolated black punctate spot located in the upper-left quadrant of the white lobe surface.
